title: My Medicines: Review
about: A review of everything the patient takes, as at a brown-bag visit: the medicines on file, printed when a patient is chosen, to check and correct, then anything else they take, including over-the-counter medicines, vitamins and supplements, and how they take them. For chronic care and wellness visits.

licence.terms: CC0 1.0: dedicated to the public domain. Use and adapt it freely, with no credit needed.

blocks.text: Please bring all your medicines to your visit, in their bottles. Include ones you buy without a prescription, vitamins, supplements, herbs, inhalers, creams and eye drops.
Cross out any you no longer take. Add anything else you take below.

blocks.label: Other medicines, vitamins and supplements I take
Please check one answer for each.
items: Do you sometimes forget to take your medicines?
Do you ever skip or cut doses because of the cost?
Do any of your medicines cause problems or side effects?
Do you take medicines prescribed by more than one clinician?
Do you use more than one pharmacy?

blocks.label: Questions I have about my medicines

items: Medicine list updated in the chart
Changes explained, and the patient said back how to take them
